name: swift-section
description: Teaches coding agents to drive the swift-section CLI: Swift and Objective-C declarations, memory layout and ABI diffs recovered from a Mach-O binary or a dyld shared cache.

interface.shortDescription: Swift and ObjC declarations out of a Mach-O binary
interface.longDescription: How to drive the swift-section CLI: dump and interface for Swift declarations, objc for Objective-C headers with IMP addresses, static field-offset and enum-layout comments, and diff / snapshot / evolution for comparing the API of two builds. Covers the flag spellings and output traps that produce a plausible but wrong answer. Requires the swift-section CLI (brew install swift-section).
defaultPrompt: Dump the Swift types in this binary
Diff the Swift ABI of these two builds
Show the ObjC interface of this class
